name: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited
about: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited engages in the investment, leasing, and financing businesses in India. The company finances industrial enterprises; and invests in, buys, sells, transfers, hypothecates, deals in, and disposes shares, stock debentures, debenture stocks, securities, securities of government and local authorities, bonds, and certificates. It also offers leasing and hire purchase and/or hire purchase financing to acquire industrial and office plants, equipment, machineries, vehicles, buildings, and real estates for manufacturing, processing, transportation, and trading businesses, as well as for other commercial and service businesses. Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
